description: Container Registry's data plane accepts only registry tokens: the Microsoft Entra ID token for the spec's `https://containerregistry.azure.net` audience is traded at `POST /oauth2/exchange` for a refresh token, then at `POST /oauth2/token` for an access token scoped to the repository and actions (Microsoft Learn / Azure/acr: "AAD integration" token exchange). Name the exchange so the protocol performs it.
